EQUITY AND HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

Christopher Covington, Chair  Cheryl Koll, Commissioner
Jon Schultz, Vice Chair  Dr. Eduardo Lara, Commissioner
Richard Brown, Commissioner  M. Lissette Flores, Commissioner
Robbie Butler, Commissioner  Keyona Montgomery, Commissioner
Joshua De Leon, Commissioner  Nolan Ross Samé-Weil, Commissioner
Ricky Dockery, Commissioner

  Equity and Human Relations Commission Meeting Via Teleconference
  Oakland Marriott City Center
  Business Center
  1001 Broadway
  Oakland, CA 94607

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to Tony.Viramontes@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 941 3345 9319
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/94133459319

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

CHAIR REMARKS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55038  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, April 1, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55044  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Coalition Against Anti-
  Blackness regarding justice for Black workers in Long Beach.

  Page 1 of 2
   EQUITY AND HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55043  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the transmittal of
  a letter from the BIPOC Preservation Ad Hoc Committee to City Council, outlining
  recommendations related to the preservation and restoration of Black, Indigenous,
  and People of Color (BIPOC) Artworks in Long Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55045  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55046  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Office of Equity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Equity and Human Relations Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

3.  26-55043  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the transmittal of
  a letter from the BIPOC Preservation Ad Hoc Committee to City Council, outlining
  recommendations related to the preservation and restoration of Black, Indigenous,
  and People of Color (BIPOC) Artworks in Long Beach.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Butler, seconded by Commissioner
  Samé-Weil, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] update paragraph
  #2 to “We urgently call on the City Council to commit to a process for
  restoring the defaced BIPOC artworks in our community by August 31,
  2026.”; [2] remove all of paragraph #5; and [3] move paragraph #6
  under paragraph #3. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  9 Brown, Butler, De Leon, Lara, Lissette Flores, Montgomery, Samé-
  Weil, Schultz, Covington
  No:  0 None

4.  26-55045  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Lara, seconded by Commissioner
  Butler, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] dissolve the BIPOC
  Preservation Ad Hoc Committee; [2] create the Justice for Black Workers Ad
  Hoc Committee, consisting of Commissioner Butler, Commissioner
  Montgomery, Commissioner De Leon, Commissioner Samé-Weil, and Chair
  Covington; and [3] create the Listening Session for Education, Access, and
  Quality Ad Hoc Committee, consisting of Commissioner Lara, Vice Chair
  Schultz, and Chair Covington. The motion carried by the following vote:
